import tslearn.metrics

# Compute the Fréchet distance between two distinct time series
dist = tslearn.metrics.frechet(s1, s2)

# Compute the Fréchet distance between a time series and itself
dist_self = tslearn.metrics.frechet(s1, s1)

# A time series compared to itself must have a Fréchet distance of exactly 0.0
assert dist_self == 0.0, f"Expected distance to self to be 0.0, got {dist_self}"
# Distinct time series in the test set should have a non-zero distance
assert dist > 0.0, f"Expected positive distance between distinct series, got {dist}"

print(f"__CHECK__ frechet {dist:.4f}")
